# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Sami: Sweden 1970 and Nordic cooperation.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Swedish 1970 integration.
# Generated by tools/sweden_1970/integrate.py.
# Country-scoped; all initialisers own persistent idempotence guards.
COLDWAR_SWE_initialise_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_SWE_1970_focus } }
            load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_SWE_1970_focus
        }
        COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialise_effect = yes
        COLDWAR_SWE_systems_initialise_effect = yes
        COLDWAR_SWE_starting_logistics_effect = yes
    }
}

# Called only from the native monthly currency calculation. Book value is never
# cash or foreign earnings. The accumulator is consumed even at the pressure cap.
COLDWAR_SWE_currency_flow_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            tag = SWE
            original_tag = SWE
            IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
            has_variable = COLDWAR_SWE_net_external_earnings
            check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
        }
        set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure = COLDWAR_SWE_net_external_earnings }
        divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure = gdp_total }
        multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure = 0.05 }
        clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure min = -0.0005 max = 0.0005 }
        add_to_temp_variable = { currency_delta = COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure }
        set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_last_fx_pressure = COLDWAR_SWE_fx_pressure }
        set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_net_external_earnings = 0 }
    }
}
